claim: FDA PMA labeling PDFs such as accessdata.fda.gov/cdrh_docs/pdf20/P200045C.pdf are publicly downloadable, text-extractable IFUs, and the same device appears in openFDA UDI with premarket_submissions P200045.
evidence: (1) Live fetch of https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/cdrh_docs/pdf20/P200045C.pdf returned a 1.5 MB, 61-page PDF (no auth, no login). pypdf text extraction on the downloaded file succeeded: page 1 reads "Bare Stent and Non-Bare Stent Configuration / INSTRUCTIONS FOR USE (IFU)"; page 2 reads "RelayPro THORACIC STENT-GRAFT SYSTEM IFU ... Page 1 of 60 / Table of Contents / 1. ... DEVICE DESCRIPTION ... 2. INDICATIONS FOR USE ... 3. CONTRAINDICATIONS", with ~6,900 extractable characters on page 2 and ~5,400 on page 3. So it is a true text-layer IFU, not a scan. (2) FDA PMA database record https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/scripts/cdrh/cfdocs/cfpma/pma.cfm?id=P200045 lists the device as RelayPro Thoracic Stent-Graft System, applicant Bolton Medical, Inc., approval date 08/05/2021, with public links: Approval Order (P200045A.pdf), SSED (P200045B.pdf), Labeling (P200045C.pdf) and Labeling Part 2 (P200045D.pdf). The page notes the labeling is the version at original approval and may not reflect current labeling. (3) Live openFDA UDI query https://api.fda.gov/device/udi.json?search=premarket_submissions.submission_number:P200045&limit=5 returned total 2,387 records, e.g. brand_name "RelayPro Thoracic Stent-Graft System", company_name "Bolton Medical Inc.", primary DI 00843576156586, premarket_submissions submission_number P200045 with supplement numbers 000-014. Caveats found: the IFU is split across two PDFs (C and D); the posted labeling is frozen at original approval date; the pdf20 path is the 2020-series PMA directory and older PMAs (pre-~2000s) may be scanned images rather than text PDFs, which I did not test; the "pdf<NN>" directory number must be derived from the PMA number's year digits.
correction: Claim holds as stated. Precise version: P200045C.pdf is a publicly downloadable, text-layer 61-page IFU (RelayPro Thoracic Stent-Graft System, Bolton Medical; labeling continues in P200045D.pdf), and openFDA UDI returns 2,387 GUDID records whose premarket_submissions.submission_number = P200045. Note that the FDA-posted labeling is the original-approval version (not necessarily current), and text-extractability of older PMA labeling PDFs (pre-2010s scans) was not verified.
impact_on_candidate: No negative impact; the pairing is verified end to end for this example. For the demo, use the C+D PDF pair together, be explicit that FDA-posted labeling reflects original approval (a useful talking point for label-vs-IFU version drift), and prefer recent PMAs (pdf15-pdf25 directories) to be sure of text layers; fall back to OCR for older scanned labeling.
